name: Bi-Directional Differentiable Point Cloud Rasterization
definition: A bi-directional point splatting approach from input views to a common novel view space and back, using EWA filtering with Jacobians to allow per-view attribute optimization.
summary: Bi-directional differentiable point cloud rasterization renders novel views by projecting points bidirectionally using EWA filtering, enabling gradient flow from novel to input views for optimizing per-view attributes.
